title: The Manager — EN/IT/DE (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar dry wit spoken word observational absurdist 106bpm upright bass brushed snare deadpan baritone male vocal English Italian German language learning trilingual football
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
The manager stands in the technical area
The precise limits of what a manager can actually do
Once the whistle goes

[Verse 2 — Italiano]
L'allenatore aveva un piano [The manager had a plan]
Il piano era eccellente [The plan was excellent]
Il piano teneva conto della maggior parte delle cose [The plan accounted for most things]
Non teneva conto del terzino sinistro [It did not account for the left back]
Che aveva un piano completamente diverso [Having a completely different plan]
Dal momento in cui il gioco è iniziato [From the moment play began]

[Chorus — English]
The manager says — this is what we trained for, stick to the shape
The players say — yes gaffer
And then do what the game requires
Which is frequently not the shape

[Bridge — Deutsch]
Chas sagte — der Trainer ist die optimistischste Person im Fußball [Chas said — the manager is the most optimistic person in football]
Sie glauben zu Beginn jeder Saison [They believe at the start of every season]
Dass die Spieler diesmal tun werden [That this time the players will do]
Genau das was im Training besprochen wurde [Exactly what was discussed in training]
Chas sagte — das ist in der Geschichte des Spiels noch nie passiert [Chas said — this has never happened in the history of the game]

[Verse 3 — English]
The plan met reality — and one of them blinked

[Outro — EN/IT/DE]
The manager
L'allenatore [The manager]
Der Trainer [The manager]
That's my boy
